title: A new model: order, progress and exports
goal: Read how positivism and the export economy shaped the liberal period, and use ordering markers to weigh its gains and its limits.

items: Use ordering markers (*primero*, *además*, *por un lado… por otro lado*, *por último*) to organise an explanation of the liberal period.
Say what the slogan order and progress meant.
Say how the export model worked.
Use the key words of this lesson: positivism, slogan, investment, unequal and interruption.
